name: Santa Maria de Martorelles (Spain)
description: Dark green field with the first vertical third yellow and two white fleurs-de-lis side by side on the green.
history: The flag was approved on 12 June 2007 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4915 of 29 June 2007; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, dark green, with the first vertical third yellow and two white fleurs-de-lis each 11/36 of the height, placed side by side and separated by their own width.

features.role: two fleurs-de-lis side by side, 11/36 of the height
